Vacancy for Lab Technician
Monday, 05 October 2026
130 Hits
Letter of Offer for carrying out Contractual Assignment against the post of Laboratory Technician in Mortuary are invited. The Contractee should meet the following eligibility criteria:
Bachelor of Forensic Sciences or B.Sc. in Paramedical Technology in Laboratory.
Having minimum one year work experience as Mortuary Laboratory Technician in Medical College / Government recognized hospitals.
Should have valid registration as per Maharashtra Paramedical Council Act, 2011.
Should have passed MSCIT.
Offer appended with the copies of relevant documents supporting the required eligibility, Aadhar Card and/or PAN Card should be submitted to the Office of Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram latest by 26/10/2026, 5.00 PM. Consideration payable shall be on locum basis as per the norms of Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram.
Note
:
Only shortlisted candidates fulfilling eligibility criteria may be called for documents verification / appraisal.
Decision of the selection committee shall be final & binding.
Dean reserves the right to reject any or all proposals.
No TA and DA will be paid for appraisal / documents verification.
DEAN, MGIMS
